newsitem.title: USA: Firm begins trials on plant-based anti-HIV agent.
newsitem.headline: Firm begins trials on plant-based anti-HIV agent.

text.p: Sarawak MediChem Pharmaceuticals Inc, of Lemont, Ill., said Friday it had begun screening patients for Phase IA clinicial trial of Calanolide A, an anti-HIV agent.

Sarawak said Calanolide A was discovered by scientists of the Arnold Arboretum of Harvard University in the rainforest of Sarawak, Malaysia. It is the only known plant-based compound to go into clinical trial against HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, the company said.
Fifty patients will be chosen for the study, which will be performed in the U.S. and is designed to assess the safety and tolerability of the compound, Sarawak said.
